name: http-request-otp-poll-extract
description: httpRequest polls a mailbox response until a message appears, binds it, and extract narrows the snippet to the code with a regular expression.
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: otp recipe
env:
  email: qa@atomyx.test
---
- httpRequest:
    url: "http://localhost:8025/api/v1/search?query=to:${email}"
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer token"
    as: inbox
    poll:
      until: $.body.messages[0].Snippet
      interval: 500
    timeout: 10000
- extract:
    from: inbox
    values:
      otp:
        path: $.body.messages[0].Snippet
        regex: "\\b(\\d{6})\\b"
- assertExpr:
    expr: "otp == \"482913\""
